description: Cases of assignment.constant_within_unit, assignment.unit_in_random_part and assignment.design_df: declared and inferred levels, mixed units, coverage by a random intercept, coarser grouping factors, design degrees of freedom with and without blocks, units nested within their parents, the rows and levels of an assignment, a missing declaration or assignment block and the counts of units resolved for the disclosure unit.

cases.description: arm is declared as randomised between classes with school as a block. It is constant within each of the four classes, each with three pupils of the disclosure unit, the one unit with the role participant, so the counts of classes are non-person counts. The model has a random intercept for class, and the fixed part leaves out the block school: messages constant, unit_present and blocks_missing, with two design degrees of freedom.

message.text: 'arm' is constant within every level of 'class' (4 in all), the unit to which it was assigned between units, a level that is declared.

The assignment of 'arm' was blocked by 'school', which the fixed part does not include. 'class', to which 'arm' was assigned at a level between units that is declared, leaves 2 degrees of freedom between its 4 levels after the fixed effects.
A random intercept of the model is on a grouping factor that matches 'class', the unit by which 'arm' was randomised, at a level between units that is declared.

cases.description: The block school is in the fixed part, which uses one more degree of freedom between classes: message design_df with 1 degree of freedom, in the singular.

message.text: 'class', the unit to which 'arm' was assigned at a level between units that is declared, has 4 levels and leaves 1 degree of freedom between them after the fixed effects.

cases.description: With school and a class-level covariate z in the fixed part, the four fixed columns that are constant within classes use the four classes, so design_df is 0 and the finding is consequential with the message no_df.

message.text: No degrees of freedom remain between the 4 levels of 'class' after the fixed effects, so the effect of 'arm', assigned to 'class' at a level between units that is declared, cannot be compared with variation between units.

cases.description: One pupil of class c2 has the other arm, so arm takes two values within 1 of the 4 classes: message mixed, consequential. The level stays declared as between_unit, so the other two checks apply. The arm that varies within c2 adds a column to the within-class part, which gives 3 design degrees of freedom.

cases.description: The only random intercept is on school, whose levels each contain whole classes: coverage is absent and school is a coarser factor, so the finding is consequential with the message unit_missing.

message.text: 'arm' was randomised by 'class', at a level between units that is declared, but no random intercept of the model is on a grouping factor that matches the 4 levels of 'class'. Grouping factors at higher levels, which do not account for the dependence between rows of one 'class': 'school'. Add a random intercept for 'class', analyse 'class' means or use cluster-robust inference at that level.

cases.description: class has a random slope without an intercept and pupil, with one row per level, has a random intercept, so neither gives coverage. class divides the rows like the unit and so is not a coarser factor, and the levels of pupil do not contain whole classes: message unit_missing_alone.
